name: Neral
description: Neral was a planet located in the Neral system in the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds that was orbited by one moon. Neral had been a rich planet, with many natural resources, but volanic eruptions destabilized the planet's core and caused the planet to explode. Only an asteroid field and its moon remained in its place.
